conclusions.text: For the exact pinned 2020 source and exact 214 subjects, direct coordinate inspection yields 213 zero-ring features and one five-ring feature (Itatí); output corrects exactly 213 false flags while retaining every other table cell and summary.

National completeness remains unresolved: the prior pinned #443 source register records 525 full-object features while pinned metadata declares 526 ADM2 units; this 214-subject correction identifies no missing national feature.

No current legal boundary, physical/legal ring meaning, island identity, regional approval, import readiness or publication is established. The later Georef layer is comparison context with mixed granularity, not legal adjudication.
